description: Discover the best hotels in Rotorua, New Zealand. Find exclusive deals and luxury accommodations.

hotels.title: Sophisticated Rotorua Lakeside Retreat with Onsite Dining & Geothermal Mineral Pool
hotels.description: Time to check into pure comfort with Lake Rotorua practically in your backyard, where geothermal wonders let the earth breathe and nature paints its masterpieces. Enjoy complimentary access to geothermal pools, bubble away in the hotel's hot tub, grab a drink on the lakeview terrace at Clarke's Bar and tuck into some tasty bites at Atlas Restaurant. At the Novotel Rotorua Lakeside, you'll find yourself at the centre of the excitement, mere steps away from the lively Eat Street with everything from steaks to ice cream. Sail down the luge at Skyline Rotorua, experience the rush of jet boating on the lake, or learn more about Māori culture and New Zealand's geothermal landscape at Te Puia.

hotels.title: New Zealand Luxury Retreat near Lake Rotorua with Daily Breakfast & Dining Credit
hotels.description: Pullman Rotorua offers a serene place to unwind at the centre of New Zealand's geothermal wonderland. Step outside to explore Pōhutu Geyser, bubbling mud pools and natural hot springs, then return to your room overlooking either Rotorua city or the shimmering waters of the nearby lake. The city's best restaurants, boutique shops and entertainment are all within walking distance of this five-star retreat. Unwind with delicious cocktails at the onsite bar or let expert chefs at Barrel & Co. showcase the region's finest ingredients. From modern amenities to extremely attentive service, every detail is designed to give you an exceptional experience. This is true five-star comfort combined seamlessly with outdoor adventure.

hotels.title: Sophisticated Pullman City Break near Lake Rotorua with Onsite Brasserie & Day Spa
hotels.description: Uncover the beauty of New Zealand's geothermal wonderland with a stay at this stylish urban sanctuary cradled in the heart of Rotorua. Be it leisure or adventure, this luxurious hotel is stamped with trademark Pullman hospitality and superbly situated for easy access to the city's top attractions, including Lake Rotorua and the Government Gardens. Spend your days exploring the nearby shooting geysers, bubbling mud, natural hot springs, lush forests and Maori cultural centres, or enjoy the vibrant atmosphere at Eat Streat. Back at your hotel, you can relax in your plush room and indulge in farm-to-table delights at Barrel & Co. Bar and Grill, while sipping on refreshing drinks.

hotels.title: Modern Rotorua Lakefront Stay near Polynesian Spa with Geothermal Pool & Buffet Dining
hotels.description: Rotorua's largest hotel naturally boasts the best views over the city's stunning geothermal lake, while the world-renowned Polynesian Spa is right next door. This hotel stay is perfectly placed to offer the very best access to the heart of New Zealand's geothermal activity. Steps from the lake's edge and a minute's walk from the Polynesian Spa in all its mud bathing glory, Sudima Hotel has proudly offered the most authentic stay in Rotorua for 25 years. Drive 20 minutes around Lake Rotorua to reach the famous Hell's Gate Geothermal Reserve, or stay in at Sudima Hotel for a traditional Māori cultural show and hāngī buffet dinner. The hotel's geothermal heated pool is also a popular place to stop and relax from morning to night, while Okareka Restaurant & Bar has all your meals sorted from buffet breakfast to an a la carte lunch and dinner.
